Let me plan the game:

Title: "여름의 끝, 너와" or something. A dating sim with:
- Character illustration (CSS/SVG-drawn since no image assets; could use external image search but better self-contained). Draw a stylized anime-ish girl with pure SVG for reliability. Maybe use gradient-based portrait with animated eyes/blush. Avoid inappropriate content — keep wholesome romance.
- Stats: 호감도 (affection), 감정/기분, maybe trust.
- Days: 7 days, each with choices; scenes with dialogue; affection changes; multiple endings.
- Korean text with nice typography.
- Choices with effects shown as floating hearts.
- Save to localStorage.
- Mobile responsive, safe areas, touch.
- Start screen with "게임 시작", Name input for the player.
- BGM? Web Audio generated ambient tones maybe optional toggle. Keep it tasteful, off by default? Could add a small sound toggle with soft click sounds via WebAudio. Fine.
- Visual polish: gradient background, floating petals, glassmorphism cards, character portrait with animated blinking and mouth maybe. Use CSS animations.

Let me design game structure in a data file? Single index.html plus style.css plus game.js. Better split files for maintainability. Since served as static html, relative paths work.

Game design in detail:

Story: You (player, default name "민준") meet 서아 (Seo-ah) at a rooftop cafe? Setting: university festival? Let's do "벚꽃 끝자락의 카페" or summer night. 7 days leading to "여름밤 축제". Each day has 2-3 dialogue beats and one choice. Choices raise/lower affection and alignment (다정함/장난기). Final confession scene outcome based on affection + maybe "진심" meter.

Mechanics:
- affection 0-100 start 20.
- Each day: choose 1 of 3 responses; each has delta affection and a tag. Some choices require a "용기" token? Keep simple but with depth: 3 hidden traits (다정, 유머, 솔직) and Seo-ah's "이상형" preferences shift? Might overcomplicate. 
- Add "기억" system: certain choices unlock special callback dialogue later, giving bonus. Nice touch: track flags.
- Days: 1) 첫 만남 (카페 자리), 2) 비 오는 날 우산, 3) 도서관/시험, 4) 요리/야식, 5) 고민 상담, 6) 축제 준비, 7) 고백.

Also include minigame? A small touch-friendly minigame adds game feel: e.g., "마음 읽기" rhythm/timing bar where you stop a moving marker in sweet spot to pick the best response, or "하트 맞추기" catch falling hearts. Add one simple minigame per day? Could be too much. Maybe a "타이밍" minigame on day 6 that determines gift quality. Also a "대화 타이밍" mechanic: each choice has a time limit? For casual game, not necessary.

Let's implement a rhythm-ish "심장 박동 맞추기" minigame once: tap when the ring aligns, 3 rounds; performance adds affection bonus. Keep optional but fun.

Endings:
- affection >= 75: "여름의 끝에서" true ending (연인)
- 50-74: "다음 계절에" good ending (썸)
- 30-49: "스쳐 간 여름" normal
- <30: "혼자 남은 밤" bad
Also if all 3 "기억" flags: special "운명" ending? Let's have 4 endings plus secret if affection>=85 and memories>=2.

UI layout:
- Desktop: two-column: left portrait card (character, name, mood, affection meter), right dialogue/story panel. Top HUD with day and hearts.
- Mobile: portrait shrinks into top banner with the character visible, choices stacked.
- Screens: title, prologue, day scene, choice, result feedback, minigame overlay, ending.

Implement with state machine and typewriter dialogue. Add accessibility: buttons, reduced motion, keyboard 1-3 for options.

Character art: SVG anime girl. Need decent quality. I'll create an SVG portrait: long dark hair, warm brown eyes, blush, soft smile, wearing off-shoulder knit? Keep wholesome. Expression variants: smile, shy, laugh, sad, surprised by toggling classes (eyes/mouth paths). That's ambitious but doable with SVG groups: eyes open/closed, mouth paths, blush opacity. Use CSS classes on portrait: mood-happy, mood-shy, mood-sad, mood-surprised.

Alternatively use image-search skill to find a CC image. But reliability of external URLs in published site is risky and licensing. Self-drawn SVG is safe and stylized. I'll do a nice vector portrait with layered gradients and hair strands, maybe semi-realistic anime style. Let me carefully craft it.

I'll also add decorative petals via JS canvas? CSS floating petals simpler.

Audio: WebAudio soft ambient pad + click. Toggle button. Compose gentle chords (Am7 - Fmaj7 - Cmaj7 - G6) with sine oscillators and slow attack; plus optional heart chime. Default off (browsers require gesture) — enable when user taps sound button or starts game (we can start on first interaction). Keep volume low. Actually auto-starting audio on game start after user click is acceptable; but surprise audio may be annoying. I'll default ON for music at low volume since it's a dating game (user clicked start). Provide mute toggle persisted.

Save: localStorage save progress after each day; continue button on title if save exists. Reset option in ending.

Let me also add "호감도" hearts display and a diary/log? Maybe not necessary. Add small "지난 대화" log drawer? Skip.

Let's think about the dialogue data. Need substantial Korean writing, charming and natural. Let's write ~7 days × 4-6 lines, 3 choices each, with reactions per choice (a follow-up line). That's a lot of Korean text but doable. Feedback lines: each choice triggers Seo-ah response then continue.

{

After choice, show reply line, then short outro line, then "다음 날" transition.

Maybe each day has 2 choices for more engagement. 7 days × 2 choices = 14 choices, with replies. That's more writing but richer. Let's do 2 beats per day: beat A (dialogue + choice), beat B (dialogue + choice), then day end transition. Minigame on day 6 inserted between beats.

- index.html
- css/style.css
- js/story.js (dialog data)
- js/game.js (engine)
- favicon.svg maybe.
- assets/portrait.svg? Inline SVG in HTML for CSS styling of expressions. Inline is easier.

Palette: warm cream/peach + dusk lavender. Background: layered gradient sky with sun glow, blurred bokeh circles, petal particles. Cards with rounded 24px, subtle border, soft shadow. - 주인공 윤서아(24)와의 7일간的故事, 14개의 선택지
- 호감도·기억 플래그에 따라 **비밀 / 진엔딩 / 굿 / 노멀 / 배드** 5가지 결말
- 손으로 그린 SVG 일러스트 + 표정 변화(미소·수줍음·슬픔·놀람 등)
- 타이핑 연출, 선택지, 호감도 미터, 기억 토스트
- 「심장 소리 맞추기」 타이밍 미니게임
- 자동 저장·이어하기, 배경음/효과음 토글, 처음부터/타이틀 메뉴, 엔딩 후 이어보기
- 모바일 터치·세이프 에어리어 대응, 세로/가로·태블릿·소형 폰 레이아웃

**실행 방법**
```bash
cd /home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround
python3 -m http.server 3002
```
브라우저에서 `http://localhost:3002` 접속. 빌드 과정은 없습니다.

**검증 완료**
- 전체 플레이 자동 진행 → 비밀 엔딩 「너라는 계절」 도달, 콘솔 오류 없음
- 저장/이어하기, 사운드 토글, 재시작, 엔딩 이어보기 정상
- 320×568 ~ 1440×900, 태블릿, 가로 모드(844×390) 레이아웃 확인
- 짧은 화면(≤700px)에서는 초상화·선택지·계속 버튼이 한 화면에 들어오도록 압축 레이아웃 적용
